Tuska 2027: More Bands Announced, Daily Lineup Revealed and All Tickets on Sale

New additions: I Prevail, Orbit Culture, Fit For A King, Paradise Lost, Turmion Kätilöt, Speed, The Baboon Show, Conan, Tukkanuotta, Atlas, Celestial Sanctuary, Split Dogs, Cenobia, SUN 

Tuska 2027, headlined by Judas Priest, Lorna Shore and Children Of Bodom, is powering full speed ahead toward next summer. The festival, taking place at Helsinki’s Suvilahti during the first weekend of July, is taking a major step forward with the announcement of artist show days and the release of all ticket categories. In addition, 14 new acts have been added to an already heavyweight lineup. 

International Stardust, Established Legends and up-and-coming Talent 
New additions to next summer’s program include American metalcore powerhouse I Prevail, one of the leading names in modern metalcore; Swedish modern melodic death metal outfit Orbit Culture; Texas-based metalcore crushers Fit For A King; and English gothic metal pioneers Paradise Lost. 

Other British representatives joining the bill include the caveman battle doom force Conan, rising death metal act Celestial Sanctuary, and high-octane rockers Split Dogs. 

Flying the Australian flag are hardcore sensation Speed and the enigmatic Cenobia. 

Alongside Orbit Culture, Stockholm street-rock favorites The Baboon Show are also representing Sweden. 

Adding a continental European touch is French artist SUN, whose music combines infectious hooks with unconventional and organic riff-driven heaviness. 

Representing Finland’s renowned metal pedigree are the beloved and award-winning Turmion Kätilöt who are fresh off the release of their new album Resondance, suburban death metal crew Tukkanuotta, and the modern yet mystical metalcore outfit Atlas.
